question: Does adding only PLAY.targetIdx and DIE.idx to the existing identity-proved research trace preserve every frozen result, policy, RNG cursor and pre-existing trajectory field across the exact same 256 policy-seed identities while producing a valid fixed scalar schema?
hypothesis: Both values already exist in the deterministic combat event queue and are copied only by BalanceSim's observation harvest loop, so removing the added targetIdx fields and dies container must reproduce the frozen trace exactly without changing the run path or RNG identity.

fields.producer: A Dusk single-target Attack resolves while its selected target remains alive.
fields.mediator: One turn-local previous-target integer plus one paid Boolean; no RunState or save field.
fields.consumer: The next single-target Attack selects a different living target in the same player turn.
fields.payoff: Request exactly one bounded Ember after valid consumption, at most once per turn.
fields.lifecycle: Reset at player-turn start and combat end; target death clears; same-target replaces without paying; other scopes and card types do not consume.
fields.naturalCost: Acquire, draw and pay for two existing single-target Attacks in a multi-enemy fight while keeping the first target alive.
fields.acquisition: None; current-main pools, rarities, deck and save representation remain unchanged.
fields.duskBoundary: Existing Emberheart only; Ashwarden and off are exact current-main paths.
fields.factorIsolation: Scoreline and Afterimage are separate fixed-off factors; no status, Facet, Shatter, Ward or authored scope change is read.
fields.rngAndPersistence: No RNG, cursor, persistent field, internal ID, save version, content entry or UI change.
fields.telemetry: Producer, survival, mediator, same-target, forced-death, consumer, payoff and expiry with exact indices and requested/realised Ember.

traceDefinition.schema: Every candidate trajectory has exactly the frozen anchor keys plus dies. Every PLAY has exactly fight,event,id,uid,targetIdx.
